# `Settle`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Imager-side wait for guiding to settle (dither or guide start).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, WaitGuideSettle @0x181ea0, StartDither @0x182790, DoDither @0x182f80 (64-bit build); 32-bit counterparts for WaitGuideSettle and StartDither |

S family, emitted by the imager. Sent from the wait-for-guide-settle, start-dither and do-dither paths while the imager waits for the guider to settle. state is a caller-supplied literal (including complete and fail); no closed list is established. error and code only for a supplied code greater than zero. Not the guider's Settling event and not its schema. Broadcast on TCP 4700 to every retained socket. The app defines the name as a constant but no event branch handling it is established. The 32-bit evidence covers the wait and start-dither paths; a do-dither counterpart is not cited.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Settle"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Caller-supplied literal, including complete and fail. Open set. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if caller-supplied code > 0 | - | Message for code. The S helper writes it only when the caller supplies a code greater than zero. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if caller-supplied code > 0 | - | Written only when the caller supplies a code greater than zero; never written as 0 by this helper. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete - Settled (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"Settle","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete"}
```

Event, fail - Settle failed (READ shape; code and message invented):

```json
{"Event":"Settle","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","error":"fail to operate","code":1}
```
